verses.2: Even today, I still clench my hands together due to my sadness.
verses.3: I will find it out, and I will discover it. I will come to it before it is completely prepared.
verses.4: I will judge him before his face, and his mouth will be filled with words of judgment.
verses.5: I know the words will answer me. But what shall my father say to me?
verses.6: The powerful enemy fights against me. He will surely defeat me.
verses.7: There, he will be remembered forever, and his name will be honored eternally among the judges.
verses.8: I also went away before he came. He isn’t here anymore, and I don’t understand him at all.
verses.9: Shamol in his actions; he doesn’t hold onto anything. I won’t see him either.
verses.10: For I know that by standing with Amidi in Hananay, I will be like gold.
verses.11: As he held my feet, I kept walking, without stopping.
verses.12: The commandment of his lips; I will not speak words that are forbidden by my covenant.
verses.13: And he was alone; who could bring him back to life? His soul was gone, and he died.
verses.14: For they will establish laws and regulations, and they will also have many officials with them.
verses.15: Therefore, from his side, I am terrified and afraid of him.
verses.16: And it was worth it for my heart; my tears made me see clearly.
verses.17: For I have not been destroyed by darkness, nor by the shadow of death.
